headline: Co z zyskiem NBP? Nowy wiceprezes zabiera głos
summary: NBP deputy governor Przemysław Litwiniuk said market developments have worsened the outlook for a 2026 profit. Whether extra funds flow to the state budget in 2027 depends on the central bank's result.
why: The National Bank of Poland's annual profit determines whether it transfers extra funds to the state budget, which affects Polish public finances.
